items.en: Sem searches and reads everything in your Canvas courses, including page text, discussions and your teachers' feedback, and can tell you what is new across a term.
items.zh: Sem 可以搜索和读取 Canvas 课程里的全部内容（包括页面正文、讨论和老师的评语），还能告诉你整个学期有哪些新动态。

items.en: The course schedule groups sections by type, pre-fills the next section code, and can merge a section into an existing one with the same code.
items.zh: 课程课表按教学班类型分组，新建时预填下一个编号，并可将教学班并入编号相同的已有教学班。

items.en: Sensitive account actions now confirm it's you in place, with your password, an email code or Google, instead of signing you out.
items.zh: 敏感的账户操作改为就地确认身份（密码、邮箱验证码或 Google），不再需要退出重新登录。

items.en: Connect Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code, Codex and other MCP clients from Settings in two steps, with the API token already filled in.
items.zh: 在设置中两步连接 Cursor、Claude Code、VS Code、Codex 等 MCP 客户端，API 令牌自动填好。

items.en: Unsent messages and attachments in Sem are kept when you open settings, switch pages or close the panel, and Sem reopens the conversation you were in.
items.zh: 打开设置、切换页面或关闭面板时，Sem 中未发送的内容和附件会保留，再次打开时回到原来的对话。

items.en: The sidebar shows a course's full title on hover only when the row shows its alias or code.
items.zh: 侧边栏的课程行只在显示别名或代码时，才在悬停时显示完整课程名称。

items.en: The forecast chart shows each assessment's full name without overlapping, labels the hidden GPA, and the grade breakdown's tooltip no longer slides in on hover.
items.zh: 成绩预测图完整显示每项考核的名称、不再重叠，隐藏的 GPA 有了标注，成绩构成的提示框悬停时也不再滑动。

items.en: Removed redundant hover tooltips from the calendar and timetable pages.
items.zh: 去掉了日历与课表页面上多余的悬停提示。

items.en: Changing a section to a code that is already taken no longer fails with an unknown error.
items.zh: 把教学班改成已被使用的编号时不再提示未知错误。

items.en: Expanding a section in the course schedule no longer shifts the table, and its times slide open smoothly.
items.zh: 展开课表中的教学班时表格不再跳动，上课时间平滑展开。

items.en: A part of a course the instructor hid in Canvas now says so instead of failing to load.
items.zh: 老师在 Canvas 里隐藏的课程部分现在会直接说明，不再显示加载失败。
